questions.prompt: How should the iterative research loop be enabled by default?

options.text: Enabled by default for all runs (behavior change)
Disabled by default; enable via config (quality profile/adapter config)
Disabled by default; enable via per-run CLI/API flag only
Enabled only when heuristics detect a multi-step dependency prompt

questions.prompt: What should be the primary stop criteria for the loop?

options.text: Fixed iterations only (e.g., always 3)
Stop when an iteration finds no net-new sources
Composite: gap-analysis stop OR diminishing returns OR budgets OR iteration cap
Stop when verifier coverage reaches a configured threshold
Stop only when runtime budget is exhausted

questions.prompt: How should the system decide what to research next each iteration?

options.text: Use synthesis unknowns/negative space only
Use verifier coverage/issues only (no additional model call)
Dedicated gap-analysis model call: reads plan + synthesis + verification and outputs next steps (JSON)
Heuristic broadening of original queries (no reflection step)
Human-in-the-loop approval between iterations

questions.prompt: What synthesis strategy should we use across iterations?

options.text: Re-synthesize from scratch each iteration using all evidence (simplest, costlier)
Incrementally refine prior synthesis using only new sources (cheaper, drift risk)
Hybrid: lightweight interim synthesis each iteration + one full synthesis at the end
No interim synthesis; synthesize only once at the end

answers.notes: let's implement two modes.. B and C. Only use C when reviewer pass is finding critical issues 2x iterations. (use verifier/verifierStrong for review passes)

questions.prompt: How should per-iteration retrieval be budgeted?

options.text: Fixed small batch (e.g., 3 queries, 5 sources) for every iteration
Scale batch size by remaining global budget (more early, fewer later)
Use global budgets in first iteration only (current behavior)
Per-iteration cap + global cap (sourcesPerIteration + maxSources)
Require per-run user settings; no defaults

answers.notes: keep globals the same, per iteration should be 1/5 of the global or 20 sources whichever is greater.

questions.prompt: What intermediate artifacts should be persisted and exposed?

options.text: Persist all iteration artifacts and expose them by default
Persist all iteration artifacts; expose only final output unless debug/advanced
Persist only the latest iteration (overwrite) to save space
Persist minimal artifacts (gap analysis + final memo only)

questions.prompt: How should the plan be updated over time during the loop?

options.text: Overwrite a single mutable plan artifact each iteration
Keep the original plan immutable and add plan versions per iteration (history)
Maintain a separate live plan artifact; keep original plan unchanged
Do not update the plan; only generate next queries
Store plan changes only as run events (no plan artifacts)

questions.prompt: Where should the loop logic live to keep the codebase testable and maintainable?

options.text: All in packages/core orchestrator (single file)
Extract loop planner to a new module in packages/core; orchestrator wires it
Put the loop in apps/worker; keep core single-pass
Implement as API-driven sequencing in apps/api (core unchanged)

questions.prompt: For auto-switching from Mode B (incremental) to Mode C (hybrid), what should count as a critical reviewer issue and how should the ‘2x iterations’ rule be applied?

options.text: Critical = reviewer verdict reject; switch after 2 rejects (not necessarily consecutive)
Critical = reviewer verdict reject; switch after 2 consecutive rejects
Critical = reject OR (revise with unsupportedConclusions>0); switch after 2 consecutive critical iterations
Critical = any verdict other than accept; switch after 2 consecutive non-accept iterations
No auto-switch; mode is fixed per run via config

questions.prompt: How should verifier vs verifierStrong be used for synthesis review passes?

options.text: Always use models.verifier for review
Use models.verifier; if verdict != accept, re-run once with models.verifierStrong and treat that verdict as authoritative
Always use models.verifierStrong for review
Use models.verifier during iterations; use models.verifierStrong only for the final full synthesis review
Disable model-based review; rely on deterministic citation validation only

questions.prompt: When Mode C (hybrid) is activated mid-run, should the system stay in Mode C for the rest of the run?

options.text: Yes—once switched, stay hybrid until finalize
Switch to hybrid for one iteration only, then try incremental again
Switch to hybrid; revert back to incremental after 2 consecutive accept reviews
Never switch automatically; mode is fixed per run
